final: WITH group_counts AS (SELECT a.translink, t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS group_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON a.translink = r.transreg COLLATE BINARY JOIN trader AS t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY a.translink COLLATE BINARY, t.tradekind COLLATE BINARY), type_sums AS (SELECT tradekind, SUM(group_count) AS total_count FROM group_counts GROUP BY tradekind COLLATE BINARY), ratios AS (SELECT g.tradekind, g.group_count, CAST(g.group_count AS REAL) / s.total_count AS ratio FROM group_counts AS g JOIN type_sums AS s ON g.tradekind = s.tradekind COLLATE BINARY), type_averages AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio FROM ratios GROUP BY tradekind COLLATE BINARY) SELECT r.tradekind, AVG(r.group_count) AS average_group_count, AVG(r.ratio) AS average_ratio, AVG(r.ratio - a.average_ratio) AS average_difference FROM ratios AS r JOIN type_averages AS a ON r.tradekind = a.tradekind COLLATE BINARY WHERE r.ratio > a.average_ratio GROUP BY r.tradekind COLLATE BINARY
